name: userGivenTable
label: User given table
description: The table that you want to view in the modal

name: label
label: Label
description: The string after 'Add' that you want to appear at the top of the modal

name: parentFieldName
label: Parent field name
description: The field name of the parent table in the M2M table

name: referencedFieldName
label: Referenced Field Name
description: The field name of the referenced table in the M2M table

name: extensionPoint
label: Extension point
description: Advanced filtering endpoint that can be defined when more filtering logic is needed inside of the list that renders in the modal

name: view
label: View
description: The type of list view you want to render inside the modal

name: columns
label: Columns
description: The columns you want to render in the list

name: hideSelectAll
label: Hide Select All
description: The property for hiding 'select all' button

name: type
label: Type
description: The association type, either one-to-many or many-to-many

name: table
label: Table
description: Normally given by declarative actions, but if setup in UIB, must be provided. The table this related list action is to display on

name: parentRecordSysId
label: Parent record sys_id
description: Normally given by declarative actions, but if setup in UIB, must be provided. The sys_id of the record the related list shows up on

name: referenceFilterField
label: referenceFilterField
description: The reference field name to be shown in the mra modal.

name: referenceFilterQuery
label: referenceFilterQuery
description: The query to be applied on the reference table.

name: referenceFilterLabel
label: referenceFilterLabel
description: The label of the reference field shown in the modal.

name: asyncProperties
label: Async properties

asyncThreshold.description: Threshold limit to start async operation, number should be greater than or equal to one.

enableAsync.description: Boolean flag which indicates to enable asynchronous operation.

redirectionHandled.description: Boolean flag which indicates MRA succes notification redirection is handled.

relatedListLabelName.description: Related list label name to show on the asynchronous status notification.

description: Object containing the data needed for mra async operation and pass back in amb notifications.
